text: This solution, Infrastructure for Safer and Resilient Schools (ISRS) Project addresses natural catastrophe in Philippines between Department of Education (DepEd), Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) Board, World Bank (International Bank for Reconstruction and Development, and IBRD). The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
